centres.name: INAIL Centro Protesi
centres.specialism: One of Europe’s leading prosthetics centres: fitting, rehabilitation and applied research under one roof, accredited by the Emilia-Romagna region. “I was looking for active prostheses, not passive ones: something alive. I wanted to humanise the prosthesis” (Johannes Schmidl, its first technical director). The DysNet board visited in August 2024.
